title: Customers receiving incorrect items instead of their orders
situation: 17 customers received the wrong items with SAR 2,019 at risk and 3 VIPs affected.
hypothesis: Fulfillment center packed incorrect items for recent orders.

params.reply_en: We sent you the wrong item. We are shipping the correct one today and you can keep or donate the item you received.
params.reply_ar: وصلك الطلب الخطأ بالغلط. راح نشحن لك الطلب الصحيح اليوم، وتقدر تحتفظ بالقطعة اللي وصلتك أو تتبرع فيها.

actions.why: Acknowledge the mistake immediately and confirm the replacement without asking for a return.

actions.note: Investigate incorrect picking at fulfillment center for recent batch.
